name: Oswin Crowthorne
source_profile:
Earl Oswin Crowthorne, House Crowthorne 
Oswin is the younger brother of the deposed Earl Alaric Crowthorne. Unlike his brother, Oswin 
opposed the rebellion. He believed secession would destroy the kingdom and refused to 
contribute his own household troops to the northern armies. Whether his opposition arose from 
genuine loyalty to the crown, personal ambition, or longstanding resentment toward his older 
brother is disputed.  
 
Before the war, Oswin swore allegiance to King Dedericus, and entered royal service, providing 
intelligence about northern fortifications and troop movements. He personally led the forces 
escorting a cadre of royal officers to Brackenford, which culminated in the Red Steps of 
Brackenford, an event regarded by most as the inciting incident of the Cadorian civil war. 
Following the rebellion's defeat and Alaric's disappearance, King Dedericus IV recognized 
Oswin as the rightful Earl of Greywatch. He now rules from the same ancestral seat that his 
brother once occupied. 
Political tension: Oswin is considered a traitor by many of his former family's retainers. Some 
believe he deliberately engineered his brother's downfall. This also makes the Ashen Vow much 
more personally connected to the war. Dame Ysabet Crowthorne is Alaric's daughter, making 
Oswin her uncle. She regards her uncle as a usurper who betrayed his own blood for a crown. 
And if Alaric is still alive somewhere in the eastern wilderness, the question of Greywatch's 
rightful succession remains extremely dangerous.
